coreBoosterPost2016.appliesTo: TCG core booster sets from Breakers of Shadow (2016) onward, incl. all 2023-2025 core sets in this file; 24 packs/box, 9 cards/pack, 1 foil per pack

tiers.source: Yu-Gi-Oh! Wiki (Fandom), Super Rare: from Breakers of Shadow the chance of pulling a Super Rare was raised to 3:4 with the guaranteed foil
Yugipedia, Ultra Rare: booster-pack Ultra ratio changed to 1:6 in 2016 (citing Konami, Kevin Tewart, 'Booster Pack Changes in 2016')
Yugipedia, Secret Rare: Secret odds increased starting from Breakers of Shadow to 1:12
Community case-opening consensus: approx. 1 Starlight Rare per 2 cases (case = 12 boxes = 288 packs); some sources say 1 per 2-3 cases. CardVault by Tom Brady; SquareRootNola FAQ aggregation

coreBoosterPost2016.note: Super+Ultra+Secret foil-slot shares sum to 100% of the 1 foil/pack slot (75+16.67+8.33). Starlight Rare (and, in 2023-2025 sets, Quarter Century Secret Rare) takes a foil slot when it appears, slightly depressing the base shares; QCSR core-set frequency is NOT recorded - no source opened in this pass states a numeric rate, see gaps.

gameWideCommunityConsensus.scope: Game-wide community consensus. Legendary/Foil Legendary: classic-era average across sets 1-5+ openings (Lorcana Player). Enchanted: catalog-wide consensus (Tome Collective, corroborated by Dexerto and CGMag community polling at 1 in 96). Iconic: Fabled-onward sets only. Foil (any): guaranteed pack structure.
gameWideCommunityConsensus.source: Tome Collective — Lorcana Rarity Tiers, Explained; Lorcana Player — Lorcana Card Rarities, Pull Rates + Foils Explained; Dexerto — Disney Lorcana rarities explained
gameWideCommunityConsensus.notes: Iconic oneInX 1500 is the low end of Tome Collective's sourced 1-in-1,500-to-2,000 range (CGMag community polling also cites 1 in 1500). Legendary 1-in-6 is the non-foil rare-slot rate; a foil Legendary adds ~1 in 50 on top. Conflicting Enchanted estimates exist: 1 in 72 (Card Gamer 250-pack TFC study) and ~1 in 100 (Lorcana Player / Cardmarket) — see gaps.

gaps: ROF, INK, URS, SSK, AZS, ARI, ROJ (sets 2-8): no set-specific quantified pull-rate sample found. Card Gamer states rates were unchanged from set 1 through set 8 (Reign of Jafar), so eraAverages are the sourced fallback — not recorded per-set to avoid presenting an era figure as set-specific data.

WIN (Winterspell): no quantified set-specific pull-rate sample found (only unquantified opening videos/anecdotes). Era averages + Fabled-onward Epic/Iconic existence apply, but no per-set numbers are recorded.

Epic: quantified per-pack rate exists only for AOV (TCG Talk 216-pack sample, 25 Epics). For FAB, WHI, WIN, WUN, sources quantify Epic only relatively ('rarer than Legendary, more common than Enchanted'; 18 Epic cards per set; ~1 in a single review box for Fabled per TheGamer) — no sourced per-pack rate, so no Epic numbers are recorded for those sets.

Iconic: no set has a confirmed set-specific rate. Zero Iconics were observed in the 216-pack AOV sample and in the 192-230-pack samples Tome Collective cross-referenced. Only the era range (1 in 1,500-2,000 packs) is sourced; TCG Talk's AOV-page aside of '~1 per case (96 packs) or rarer' conflicts with that range and is treated as speculation (flagged on that page itself), so it is not recorded as a rate.

Enchanted rate disagreement across sources: 1 in 72 (Card Gamer, 250 TFC packs, 2023) vs ~1 in 96 (Dexerto / Tome Collective catalog-wide consensus / CGMag polling) vs ~1 in 100 (Lorcana Player multi-set average / Cardmarket). Dataset uses 1 in 96 as era average, 1 in 72 for TFC (its own study), 1 in 100 for FAB (Cardmarket's Fabled-specific statement). No source reconciles the three; treat all as estimates.

Legendary rate disagreement: 1 in 5 (Card Gamer 250-pack TFC study) vs 1 in 6 non-foil slots (Lorcana Player multi-set average, corroborated by Cardmarket and SSR TCG's ~4/box) vs ~6 per box in Wilds Unknown / AOV under reportedly improved 2026 pull rates. Recorded as found per source; not harmonized.
AOV Enchanted (6 in 216 packs, 1 in 36) sits far above the catalog consensus (1 in 96) — small, creator-skewed sample flagged by the source itself; recorded as observed, not as a true rate.

No publisher rates exist: Ravensburger has never officially published pull rates for any rarity (Tome Collective; Lorcana Player: 'exact pull rates have not been revealed'). Card Gamer attributes its table to an 'official rarity guide from Ravensburger', which no other source corroborates — its numbers are therefore classed 'community', not 'publisher'.

Foil (any rarity other than Foil Legendary): foil-slot rarity splits (foil Rare ~1 in 7-8, foil Super Rare ~1 in 20-22) appear in Card Gamer / Lorcana Player but with looser, partly inconsistent figures; only the guaranteed 1 foil per pack and Foil Legendary 1 in 50 (agreed by both) are recorded.

Hyperia City (set 14) and Into the Inkdark (set 15, with Collector Boosters and a Collector-Booster-only 'Illustrious' rarity) were announced in coverage but are NOT in the app's lorcana-api set list as fetched 2026-10-11, so they are out of scope for this fragment.
